en.name: Cherry tomatoes
en.summary: Cherry tomatoes are small thin-skinned tomatoes sold loose or on the vine. Counter-intuitively they keep longer out of the fridge than in it — about 10 days at cool room temperature against about 5 days refrigerated — and the fridge also costs them their flavour.
en.pantry: A cool, shaded spot out of direct sun is where cherry tomatoes belong, and about 10 days is the working figure. Spread them in a single layer, stem side down, rather than piling them in a bowl where the ones underneath bruise. Cold below about 12 °C damages the membranes that hold a tomato's aroma compounds, which is why a refrigerated tomato tastes of so much less; leaving them out is a flavour decision as much as a storage one. Once one splits or moulds, remove it immediately — it will take the rest with it.
en.fridge: Refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, cherry tomatoes keep about 5 days — half the counter figure. The fridge is the right choice when your kitchen is genuinely hot, when the tomatoes are already fully ripe and you cannot eat them fast enough, or once they have been cut. Keep them in a shallow open container rather than a sealed bag, and take them out 30 minutes before eating so some of the aroma comes back.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for cherry tomatoes in our data, so we do not give one. They can be frozen whole on a tray and bagged, and the skins slip off under warm water afterwards, which is genuinely useful for sauces — but the texture is gone for good, so this is a cooking ingredient rather than a preserved fresh one. Roasting them first and freezing the roasted tomatoes keeps far more of what you liked.
en.thawing: Do not thaw frozen cherry tomatoes before cooking — tip them straight into the pan or the sauce. If you want to peel them, run them under warm water for a few seconds and the skins slide off.
spoilage: Split or burst skins, especially where fruit has been piled up
Wrinkled, shrunken fruit that gives easily when squeezed
White or grey fuzzy mould, usually starting at the stem scar
Weeping fruit, or a sour, fermented smell from the container
tips: Store stem side down in a single layer, out of the fridge and out of the sun.
Check the bowl daily and remove any that have split — one mouldy tomato spoils the batch.
If you must refrigerate them, bring them back to room temperature before eating.
Over-ripe tomatoes are not waste; roast them with oil and salt and they become a sauce.

faq.q: How long do cherry tomatoes last?
faq.a: About 10 days at cool room temperature and about 5 days in the fridge. Room temperature is both longer and better tasting, unless your kitchen is hot.
Generally not. Cold damages the compounds that give tomatoes their aroma and halves how long they keep. Refrigerate only fully ripe fruit you cannot eat in time, or cut tomatoes.
No timeline is published, so we do not give one. You can freeze them whole for cooking — the skins slip off afterwards — but the texture is lost permanently.

faq.q: Why do my cherry tomatoes split?
faq.a: Usually a sudden change in moisture, or pressure from being piled up. A split tomato is a way in for mould, so eat it at once or take it out of the bowl.

zh.name: 小番茄
zh.summary: 小番茄是皮薄的小顆番茄，散裝或連枝販售都有。有點違反直覺的是，它放在室溫反而比冰在冰箱更耐放——涼爽室溫約 10 天，冷藏約 5 天——而且冷藏還會讓風味大打折扣。
zh.pantry: 陰涼、避開陽光直射的地方才是小番茄該待的位置，約 10 天是工作上的參考值。請蒂頭朝下單層攤開，不要堆在碗裡，下層的很快就被壓傷。低於約 12°C 的低溫會破壞番茄鎖住香氣分子的細胞膜，這就是冰過的番茄吃起來平淡無味的原因；把它放在室溫，與其說是保存決定，不如說是風味決定。一旦有一顆裂開或發霉，請立刻挑掉，否則它會帶壞整批。
zh.fridge: 冷藏於 4°C 以下，小番茄大約可放 5 天，只有常溫的一半。什麼時候該冰？廚房真的很熱時、番茄已經全熟而你來不及吃完時，或是已經切開時。請用淺的開口容器而不是密封袋，並在食用前 30 分鐘拿出來回溫，香氣會回來一些。
zh.freezer: 我們的資料裡沒有小番茄的冷凍保存期限，所以不提供數字。它是可以整顆平鋪凍硬再裝袋的，凍過之後用溫水一沖皮就會滑下來，這對做醬料確實很方便——但口感永遠回不來，所以那是把它當成烹調材料，而不是把新鮮番茄保存下來。先烤過再冷凍烤番茄，能保留多得多的風味。
zh.thawing: 冷凍小番茄不要先解凍，直接倒進鍋裡或醬汁裡。想去皮的話，用溫水沖幾秒鐘，皮就會滑落。
spoilage: 外皮裂開或爆開，尤其是被堆壓的那些
果實皺縮變軟，輕捏就凹
長出白色或灰色的毛狀黴，通常從蒂頭疤痕開始
滲汁，或容器裡散出酸味、發酵味
tips: 蒂頭朝下、單層攤放，不冰、不曬。
每天檢查，裂開的立刻挑掉——一顆發霉會毀掉一整盒。
真的要冷藏的話，吃之前務必回溫。
過熟的番茄不是垃圾；淋油撒鹽烤一烤就是一鍋醬。

faq.a: 涼爽室溫約 10 天，冷藏約 5 天。除非廚房很熱，否則室溫既放得久、吃起來也更好。
多半不用。低溫會破壞番茄的香氣成分，還會讓保存期減半。只有全熟到來不及吃完，或是已經切開的才需要冷藏。
沒有公布的期限，所以我們不給數字。可以整顆冷凍留著煮（凍過皮很好剝），但口感會永久流失。
多半是含水量突然變化，或被堆疊壓到。裂開就是黴菌的入口，請馬上吃掉或從盒子裡拿出來。
